items.text: Vikings have ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to an ankle injury.
items.implication: MIN WR corps shuffles; Addison/others elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining MIN pass-catchers.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans is being carted off and ruled out due to a rib injury; Rapoport confirms rib strain, full eval tomorrow.
items.why: Carted after big hit; rib injury confirmed.
items.implication: Ends day early; painful, monitor Week 4 status.
items.opportunity: Other SF WRs (e.g. remaining depth) see target/route bump.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall has been ruled out with a thigh injury.
items.implication: Jets backfield opens; monitor backups for remaining snaps/carries.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for Jets RBs in committee post-Hall exit.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut.
items.why: Official active; planned limited practices earlier in week.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 lock; high target share expected on debut.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone as primary TE; Mayer handcuff fades.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane has been ruled out vs. the Chiefs due to a knee injury; coach Hafley: early eval does not sound very optimistic, fear of major injury.
items.why: Knee injury mid-game; coach major concern, gathering more info.
items.implication: Major blow; long-term stash risk if significant.
items.opportunity: MIA RB committee/handcuffs elevated (carries, targets, goal-line).

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout looking good; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout on field looked good; official active list.
items.implication: Startable but risk of limited snaps/routes; monitor usage early.
items.opportunity: Primary WR role if full; else Bateman/Andrews elevated targets/red-zone.

items.text: Risky for sure but if Flowers is active for Baltimore he's active for me. I would start him over Bateman.
items.why: Active status overrides prior GTD pessimism; better than Bateman in this spot.
items.implication: Prefer Flowers in lineups over Bateman if both available.
items.opportunity: Full WR1 role vs DAL if not heavily limited.
items.conflict: ETR/Levitan had OUT in early projs with late swap for Bateman/Andrews.

items.text: Actives today include: Bills WRs DJ Moore and Keon Coleman, Steelers RB Jaylen Warren. (Pittman expected aligned).
items.implication: Full or near-full roles confirmed for early games.
items.opportunity: Warren carries/snaps lead; Moore/Coleman targets; Pittman WR role.

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell expected inactive (finger); depth today: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett 4. Sterling Shepard 5. Malik McLain. Expecting TE Kenyon Sadiq slot/wide decent amount.
items.why: Source: expected inactive after GTD consideration; high targets prior week.
items.implication: Wilson clear alpha; Sadiq hybrid role expands opportunity.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets spike; Sadiq slot/wide snaps/targets.

items.text: Notes on ETR summary: No info yet DJ Moore/AD Mitchell (1pm). Flowers OUT in projs now (possible play, late swap Bateman/Andrews DFS). Moore in (limited), Mitchell out. Projecting Warren/Evans/Bowers IN.
items.why: Team not counting on Flowers; limited Moore assumption.
items.implication: DFS late swap prep; Warren/Bowers/Evans startable.
items.opportunity: Bateman/Andrews volume if Flowers sits; Moore limited routes.

items.text: Weekend FF reports summary: GTD Flowers (not counting on him), Spears (hopeful). Expected: Warren, Pittman, Barkley, Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson (trending right), Bagent.
items.opportunity: Full roles for expected group; Flowers uncertainty elevates Bateman/Andrews.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite prop and weak matchup for volume/TD upside.
items.opportunity: High carry/goal-line share vs soft front.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both games; RB7 utilization; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.opportunity: High target/air-yards share vs soft secondary.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/game, 3.2 ypc to RBs. (10 Facts: Henderson 65% snaps/out-touched 16-5 remainder after fumble).
items.why: Role erosion post-fumble + tough run D.
items.implication: Sit/flex down; Henderson rising but not full takeover yet.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: even with Kamara active, RB37 util; only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps. Role not there.
Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week w/ Collins out; IND 4th-most yards to TEs. (10 Facts aligns 30% routes targeted).
items.why: Elevated usage w/ Collins OUT + soft TE matchup.
items.opportunity: High target share/routes continues w/ Collins absent.

items.text: 10 Facts: After Stevenson fumble, Henderson led NE backfield 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but still ranks Stevenson ahead W3; team trust issues in pass pro for Henderson.
items.implication: Henderson stash/flex rising; monitor for lead change.
